parsed.post: The experiment with increased ASPECT_RATIO and higher learning rate slightly regressed (1.0195 vs 1.0110). Reverting to the best configuration. I suspect the learning rate was too aggressive for this depth. Next, I will focus on fine-tuning the WEIGHT_DECAY and slightly reducing the learning rate to find a more stable peak.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best and testing a lower learning rate with higher weight decay to improve regularization and stability.
